gates.criterion: Product integrity: scope, supported/unsupported features and limits are understandable; falsifiable thesis backed by observed workflows
gates.evidence_path: README.md; docs/STATUS.md; docs/launch/DECISIONS.md (L-001, L-007); site /docs/status
gates.limitations: Scope, stable/experimental/unsupported labels and limits are stated in README, STATUS and the site; thesis is falsifiable and was narrowed after the abc-v5 calibration (L-007). Workflows backing it are recorded in evidence/LIVE-JOURNEYS-2026-10-29.md.

gates.criterion: Offline value with no coding agent: analysis, context, impact/why/verify, setup, privacy audit behave honestly and safely
gates.evidence_path: dist/launch/qual-9663ac3/smoke-{macos,linux,linux-bwrap}.log; scripts/release_smoke.sh
gates.limitations: No agent installed (clean containers): quickstart, agents list/route (NO_AGENT, all NOT_INSTALLED), do --dry-run, init, context, impact, verify (linked test, inferred pytest), verify --run (sandboxed where a backend works, honest refusal otherwise), privacy audit, uninstall. Retrieval on prose queries is weak (documented).

gates.criterion: Zero/one/many provider discovery: deterministic, install-aware, policy-aware states; no surprise install/billable call/Bob default; >=1 real provider works through the sanctioned path
gates.evidence_path: evidence/LIVE-JOURNEYS-2026-10-29.md; tests/test_provider_registry.py; agents route outputs in dist/launch/
gates.limitations: Zero (container: NO_AGENT), many (host: NOT_AUTHORIZED without consent; no billable call in list/route/doctor/dry-run), one real provider through the sanctioned path (Codex, agy). Claude re-observed BLOCKED_AUTH from a real run; Gemini not re-tried.

gates.criterion: Security/containment: scopes, safe defaults, credential hygiene, positive+adversarial sandbox tests, symlink/traversal, prompt-injection hardening, OS limits disclosed
gates.evidence_path: docs/launch/evidence/FREEZE-9663ac3.md; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/VERIFY-THREAT-MODEL.md; docs/launch/PUBLICATION_AUDIT.md
gates.limitations: Full suite incl. hostile-repository, symlink/traversal, sandbox-escape and #56 tests on macOS; Linux bwrap suites in a privileged container; independent adversarial review (fixed). OS limits disclosed: Windows has no host sandbox; live-provider sandbox restricts writes, not host reads; Codex inner-sandbox bypass runs only under repo-ai's outer sandbox.

gates.criterion: Intent-to-verified-change: clean-repo workflow with a model-generated candidate, baseline, frozen acceptance, isolated write, regression, evidence, explicit apply, post-apply tests, undo
gates.evidence_path: docs/launch/evidence/LIVE-JOURNEYS-2026-10-29.md (journeys 1 and 3, incl. the freeze re-run)
gates.limitations: Synthetic constructed tasks, n=1 per build; Codex and agy only; macOS seatbelt; same author wrote task, tests and hidden oracle.

gates.criterion: Evidence semantics: verdict means exactly what was observed; requirement->test mapping; stale/changed/skipped/interrupted/no-op/false-green handled honestly
gates.evidence_path: docs/launch/evidence/FREEZE-9663ac3.md; tests/test_mission_coverage.py, test_mission_claims*.py, test_verify_*; held-out-7 (903984a) in docs/STATUS.md
gates.limitations: PASS never means correct (claims + coverage CLAIM_UNVERIFIED); stale/changed/skipped/interrupted/no-op handled by tests; this cycle fixed a launcher failure being reported as pre-existing failures. abc-v5 calibration shows coverage does not discriminate semantic false greens when both candidates pass the same tests (stated). Held-out evidence is for 903984a, not re-run.

gates.criterion: Human-useful tournament: zero/one/many; live 2-provider run; independent workspaces, identical frozen oracle; honest tie handling; explicit apply
gates.evidence_path: LIVE-JOURNEYS (journey 2 on dfb6880 and 9663ac3); tests/test_live_tournament.py
gates.limitations: Live runs: one abstention with distinct passing diffs (dfb6880) and one byte-identical pair resolved by the equivalence rule (9663ac3). A behaviourally different live tie was not exercised; the AST same-code report is covered by tests only.

gates.criterion: Verified continuity: integrity-checked handoff; genuine cross-provider partial-progress transfer; fresh verification; attacks refused
gates.evidence_path: LIVE-JOURNEYS (journey 3 on c505f74 and 9663ac3); tests/test_handoff_integrity.py, tests/test_mission_partial_handoff.py
gates.limitations: Constructed scenario (stage A scoped to one file to force partial progress), n=1 per build; seed reuse confirmed byte-identical.

gates.criterion: Failure analysis: baseline/new/flaky separated; inspectable leads with uncertainty; no fictional causal certainty
gates.evidence_path: tests/test_mission_decision_chain.py, why-test-failed tests; docs/roadmap/REALITY-ENGINE-USAGE.md
gates.limitations: Baseline/new/pre-existing/fixed separated per test; leads labelled static, never causal. No new held-out evaluation of diagnosis quality this cycle.

gates.criterion: Skills/knowledge: provenance-aware discovery or clearly unsupported; untrusted skill text cannot escalate; experimental parts labelled
gates.evidence_path: docs/STATUS.md skills rows; docs/SKILL_NETWORK.md; tests/test_skill_vet.py
gates.limitations: Inventory/vet are read-only stable candidates; discovery, install, trials and plugin inspection are labelled experimental (their fresh validations failed); skill text is never executed. Accepted as clearly experimental status, not demonstrated benefit.

gates.criterion: Change rehearsal: risk/blast-radius with transparent limits; speculation never marketed as certainty
gates.evidence_path: docs/STATUS.md; repo-ai futures --help (experimental)
gates.limitations: futures/rehearsal and impact are labelled static/heuristic with uncertainty lines; no certainty is marketed. Calibration of risk prediction is not measured (stated).

gates.criterion: First-run onboarding in a clean host/container: install, skip/configure agents, useful offline journey, clear errors; upgrade/uninstall preserve user data
gates.evidence_path: dist/launch/qual-9663ac3/smoke-*.log, upgrade/linux-journey.log
gates.limitations: Clean macOS venv; clean python:3.12-slim container (no sandbox); privileged container with bwrap; upgrade from the published dev4 wheel to repo-ai-cli 0.9.0 keeps state; uninstall keeps user CLAUDE.md edits and restores the tree. Windows not run (billable CI while private).

gates.criterion: CLI & docs quality: command reference consistent with --help, JSON/exit codes, provider/platform matrix, troubleshooting, migration
gates.evidence_path: docs/CLI-REFERENCE.md + tests/test_cli_reference.py (CI step); documented-command/flag check over README, GETTING-STARTED and every site page; site troubleshooting, install/upgrade/migration pages
gates.limitations: Site tutorial snippets are not executed in CI (release_smoke.sh covers the first-run path).

gates.criterion: Site quality: original responsive landing + docs, visual QA desktop/mobile, accessibility, SEO/social, performance, no fabricated claims
gates.evidence_path: site/ (npm run qa: build + link check + axe); screenshots site/qa/screenshots (ignored)
gates.limitations: Local build and Playwright/axe QA only: 20 pages x light/dark x 390/1440 px, 0 axe violations, 0 broken of 1,103 internal links/anchors, no overflow at 390/768/1440, 0 third-party requests, landing 19 KB gzipped. Lighthouse not run. Not yet deployed (G15).

gates.criterion: Public websites: real HTTPS URL(s), routing, 404, metadata, external smoke checks, rollback path
gates.evidence_path: https://hxxtsxxh.github.io/repo-ai/ and /docs/ (Pages run 40982105858); live crawl of all 19 sitemap URLs: 200; /does-not-exist/ 404; TLS verify 0; canonical/OG/sitemap/robots present
gates.limitations: Fetched over the public internet from the development host (not a second network). Rollback: re-run pages.yml on an earlier commit (workflow_dispatch) or disable Pages in settings. robots.txt under a project path is not read by crawlers (domain root only). Install command shows the GitHub-release wheel until PyPI publication.

gates.criterion: Python packaging: stable wheel+sdist, constraints, reproducible build, checksums, provenance, clean install from public PyPI
gates.evidence_path: https://pypi.org/project/repo-ai-cli/0.9.0/; release run https://github.com/hxxtsxxh/repo-ai/actions/runs/40985177161; docs/launch/evidence/FREEZE-9663ac3.md
gates.limitations: Published by Trusted Publishing (OIDC; no token). Wheel sha256 b351d80e… is byte-identical to the local freeze build and to a wheel rebuilt from the sdist; sdist b328ca0f… (built from the public tree; differs from the local freeze sdist only through docs). CycloneDX SBOM, SHA256SUMS and build-provenance attestations (gh attestation verify: ok) on the GitHub release. Python >=3.10, pure wheel. PyPI-side pending publisher had environment '(Any)'; GitHub's pypi environment restricts deployments to v* tags.

gates.criterion: GitHub readiness: README, community files, templates, CI with explicit skips, release automation, changelog, green branch-protected merge
gates.evidence_path: https://github.com/hxxtsxxh/repo-ai/pull/1 (merged 2026-10-30T01:57Z as 6c3b40c after 12/12 required checks); branch protection on main; community files; ci/release/pages workflows
gates.limitations: test-macos is skipped on pull requests by its own condition and runs on main pushes and tags (green on 7ca4c51). No force-push or bypass; historical tags/releases untouched (they live on the private repo-ai-dev).

gates.criterion: Public open-source status: publication-rights and secret-history audit, explicit visibility decision, source publicly accessible, licence/author accuracy
gates.evidence_path: https://github.com/hxxtsxxh/repo-ai (public, anonymous clone verified); docs/launch/PUBLICATION_AUDIT.md; scripts/public_export.py; private history at hxxtsxxh/repo-ai-dev (anonymous API 404)
gates.limitations: Owner chose the curated export (L-009). Public history is one commit by the noreply address; the export audit (corporate address, local paths, enterprise host, private-only text) and gitleaks (42 verified false positives: content hashes, vendor example key, test fixtures) are clean. MIT licence; bundled evaluation tasks keep their own licences (docs/release/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

gates.criterion: Independent evaluation: prospective preregistered study, honest CIs and false-green metrics, declared limits; no small-n superiority claims
gates.evidence_path: benchmarks/abc-v5/ (PREREGISTRATION.md, power.py, manifests, grade.py, results/calibration.json); docs/launch/EVALUATION.md; DECISIONS L-007
gates.limitations: Mission §9 fallback taken and declared: harness built and validated (sealed grader, negative controls, immutable manifests, exact power), bounded calibration run (n=4 synthetic, single author, $0), primary result NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED. The calibration falsified the strong claim (B task-level discrimination 0/4) and narrowed it. The 24-task confirmatory phase is NOT RUN: it needs blinded task authors (humans, or an approved ~$15-40 for separate AI sessions).

gates.criterion: Real integrations: actual executables/auth/sandbox tested, broken adapters labelled, real user workflow, negative tests for denial/quota/failure
gates.evidence_path: evidence/LIVE-JOURNEYS-2026-10-29.md; dist/launch/claude-probe/claude.txt; tests/test_provider_*.py (denial, quota, failure fakes)
gates.limitations: Real executables/auth/sandbox exercised for Codex 0.165.0 and agy 1.4.9 (macOS); Claude 2.1.312 re-observed as BLOCKED_AUTH in the isolated HOME and labelled so; Bob not re-run; Gemini not tried. n=1 workflows.
